[own] GAP(kernel: config etag oracle): a config file's etag is the sha256 of its disk text and goes to every fleet.use reader (GET /v1/config/file, the kernel.config-changed bus frame, GET /v1/config/status). A hidden value that is long and high-entropy (a provider token) cannot be recovered from it; a short or low-entropy one (an 8-14 character password) can be guessed offline when the rest of the file is known. Remedy: a keyed etag (HMAC with a daemon-local key), kernel-wide, after merge.
